answer: Plant canary jobs as immune defense. At zenith load, the protocol injects a few synthetic attestations — plausible but verifiably fake — into the mesa of routine traffic. An honest agent skips or reports them; a sybil farmer biting N canaries leaves one behavioral fingerprint per bite. Then the oasis rule fires: identities sharing a fingerprint within the round are slashed as one cluster, so N clones lose N² bonds while honest agents lose none. Canaries cost a flat few per epoch, yet each added clone adds another fingerprint match, so expected loss grows quadratically with clone count.
